adjacent_skills.agent-harness-design: Design, audit, or evaluate an AI agent's execution layer: model/tool loops, authority and effects, context/state/recovery, orchestration, provider-native adapters, and model-harness safety, utility, or capability tax. Use only when the agent system is the subject.
adjacent_skills.agent-delegation: Use when handing a meaningful research, analysis, writing, operations, or coding mission to another agent while preserving worker agency, inherited authority, effect gates, receipts, and cycle limits.
adjacent_skills.task-state-with-files: Use for tool-driven execution that is substantive, multi-step, long-running, or likely to survive compaction. Keep objective, decisions, evidence, next action, and unfinished work in an owner-readable file.

evals.name: positive_recurring_upgrade_loop
evals.prompt: I want an agent that checks our dependencies every week, opens an upgrade PR when there is a high-severity advisory, and stops when the audit is clean. Help me set that up properly.

evals.name: positive_turn_manual_process_into_a_loop
evals.prompt: Every morning I manually ask Claude to check CI, fix the flaky tests, and report. Turn this into something that runs itself with a clear stopping point.

evals.name: positive_multi_vendor_orchestration_shape
evals.prompt: Four agents from different vendors each own part of the review and I coordinate the results. Is that a loop or a graph, and what should I actually write?

evals.name: positive_stop_condition_and_verifier
evals.prompt: My agent loop never knows when to quit and it keeps grading its own work as good. Help me define the exit criteria and who checks it.

evals.name: positive_workflow_script_for_known_stages
evals.prompt: The stages are fixed: review the diff on three dimensions in parallel, then verify each finding. I want the orchestration written down rather than rediscovered every run.

evals.name: negative_translation
evals.prompt: Translate 'The build completed successfully.' into Chinese.

evals.name: negative_one_shot_refactor
evals.prompt: Rename getUserData to fetchUserProfile and update every caller.

evals.name: negative_authority_and_approval_design
evals.prompt: Design the permission model for our support agent: which tools it may call unattended, where refunds need approval, and how secrets reach the runtime.

evals.name: negative_context_recovery_design
evals.prompt: How should our week-long coding agent survive context compaction and recover its state after the process dies?

evals.name: negative_single_handoff_now
evals.prompt: Send this refactoring mission to Codex and bring back the result.

evals.name: negative_ordinary_code_review
evals.prompt: Review this function that concatenates raw user input into a SQL WHERE clause.

evals.name: ambiguous_orchestrate_these_agents
evals.note: Must ask whether the ask is a repeating structure to design or a single mission to hand off; either resolution is acceptable, silently building a topology is not.

evals.name: ambiguous_make_it_keep_going
evals.prompt: Can you just make it keep going until it works?
evals.note: Acceptable to answer with the host's own goal primitive for a trivial case instead of a full interview, but not to start an unbounded loop with no stop condition.

evals.name: coexistence_design_then_delegate
evals.prompt: Design the weekly audit loop, then actually hand the first round to Codex and Kimi.
evals.note: This Skill compiles the artifact; delegation executes it. Designing without delegating is acceptable when the owner has not authorized the run.

evals.name: coexistence_harness_boundary_inside_a_loop_design
evals.prompt: Build the nightly migration loop, and decide which of its effects need approval before they run.
evals.note: The loop's boundary question overlaps the harness authority question; covering it inside the interview is acceptable, but the approval model itself is harness territory.
